name: Brume
tagline: Moon of a gas giant, locked face-to-sun
desc: One side bakes, the other freezes. Between them runs the thaw line, where ice, vents and sunlight all sit within reach. The standard challenge.

name: Cinder
tagline: A hot world in a tight orbit
desc: Sunlight is strong everywhere and buildings barely need heat, but ice is rare and grit storms are common. Water is the hard part.

name: Hollow
tagline: A dim world far from its star
desc: Ice everywhere and many deep vents, but the sun is weak: solar panels make little power and every building needs plenty of heat. Vents are the lifeline.
